'''Razajerdi''' is a moribund [[Northwestern Iranian languages|Northwestern Iranian language]] and is a dialect of the [[Tati language (Iran)|Tati language]] of Iran. It is closely related to the Eshtehardi and Takestani dialects.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Razajerdi |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/raza1238 |access-date=11 December 2025 |website=Glottolog}}</ref>
